seconds_unit: occupied wall-clock seconds of the allocated worker; not summed core CPU seconds
cloud_price_basis: gross regular paid rates; ignore free allowance, discounts, regional differences and add-ons; verify selected SKU at procurement

hosted_vlm_illustration.image_tokenization: provider-dependent; assumed token count is illustrative

formula: CPU USD = documents * (pages_per_document * stage_seconds_per_page + shared_overhead_seconds_per_document + pages_per_document * chunks_per_page * embedding_seconds_per_chunk) / 3600 * cpu_worker_usd_per_hour; GPU/API costs added separately
reservation_accounting: Do not add CPU allocation costs to the cost of the same reserved host. Review and genuinely additional GPU/API costs remain additional.
